# Pipeline

## A — strategic admission
Only strategic decisions `BUILD` or `VALIDATE` compile into executable targets. BUILD must name a durable scarcity and kill/falsifier condition.

## B — underengineer
Select the minimum dependency-closed feature set that begins accumulating the scarce asset and can test the thesis. Everything else becomes explicit deferred state.

## C — foundry compilation
Selected features become capabilities, atomic requirements, evidence contracts, validators and completion circuits. No hard requirement without evidence + deterministic validator.

## D — spec gate
Binary checks: unique ids, known dependencies, acyclic graph, evidence/validator for every hard requirement, valid completion references, economic metrics if commercial success is claimed, authority declaration for external action.

## E — prebuild
Emit a GitGoblin request. Store every candidate evaluation as structured data and calculate ECC.

## F — missing delta
Only uncovered requirements become implementation tasks. Reused components still get integration + verification tasks.

## G — bridge
Emit QP and A-Task bridge JSON. Autobuild does not settle receipts or mark tasks done.

## H — execution/accretion
Every worker run emits a `RunContribution`. Failed approaches, API constraints, rejected repos and regression fixtures remain reusable data.

## I — outcome feedback
Technical outcomes feed QP, economic outcomes feed Seesaw, component reliability feeds GitGoblin, and normalized run data enters the accretion ledger.
